d: A rescue for the team involving a heart attack victim and a serious car accident scene following a family vehicle crash leaves ambulance staff needing to determine the extent of injuries at a difficult site.
The dedicated paramedics fight to save a man's life following an accidental overdose from dangerous drugs.
A doctor's trauma skills are put to the test by a dramatic accident  a cyclist with a life-threatening head injury requires attention  a speedway racer needs help after going off the track.
Teams come to the aid of a mother and daughter involved in a high-speed motorcycle crash, before helping a four-year-old girl with a serious leg fracture.

At Dublin Airport, Bruce Hellar becomes suspicious after an international traveller enters the country with only one small bag, plus customs workers in Cork search for suspicious items on a cargo ship transporting bananas.
Luggage belonging to two young men returning to Dublin from Ibiza tests positive for drugs, while the hunt is on for illegal cigarettes in Ireland's southwest.
